data.one_liner: Create customizable popup cards that overlay your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin to display popup cards and custom widgets overtop of your main application. Supports both screen-aligned positioning with offsets and anchor-aligned positioning relative to specific widgets.
use_when: You need to display lightweight dialogs or cards over your main interface.
You want to position a popup relative to a specific target widget like an icon button.
You need customizable animations, dimming, and safe area handling for popups.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-screen navigation flows.
You are building a full screen routing mechanism.
strengths: Includes built-in opening and closing animations and background dimming.
Simple API that closely mimics Flutter's built-in `showDialog`.
weaknesses: Limited to single popup card overlays rather than complete overlay management systems.
No built-in tooltip or complex contextual menu features.
